0022600217.text: The Pacers (3-7) host the Wizards (4-6) with Indiana still searching for its first home win, as it is 0-5 at home and has lost its last game, leaving it 11th in the East. Washington, 9th in the East, has dropped three straight. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Washington is without Bilal Coulibaly (hand), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in the 2025-26 season the Pacers lost the series 1-3, including a 131-118 loss in Washington on February 20.
